test_arcee_provider_aliases: test that arcee-ai and arceeai aliases resolve to the canonical arcee provider via resolve_provider

test_arcee_model_normalization: test normalize_provider and normalize_model_for_provider strip arcee prefixes from model names
test_arcee_url_mapping: test _URL_TO_PROVIDER maps api.arcee.ai to arcee and trajectory_compressor detects arcee from base_url
